table_requires: Shares used in computing net loss per share, basic and diluted
paragraph_requires: All common stock share and per share amounts and information presented herein have been retroactively adjusted
For periods in which the Company reports net losses, basic net loss per share is the same as diluted net loss per share
We effected a 15:1 reverse stock split of our common stock on March 20, 2025
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Outset Medical uses net loss rather than comprehensive loss as its EPS numerator and excludes potential dilution in the loss periods. The filing retrospectively adjusts all presented common-share and per-share information for its March 20, 2025, 15:1 reverse split. The selected values already reflect that adjustment; no further split conversion is applied. Shares are reported in thousands with scale-three tags, while EPS uses scale zero. Excluded equity awards and warrants are not added to the denominator.

table_requires: Net loss attributable to common stockholders
Weighted average shares of common stock outstanding
paragraph_requires: computed using the weighted-average number of common shares outstanding during the respective periods.
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Gladstone Land reports net income but a net loss attributable to common stockholders after cumulative redeemable preferred dividends and preferred-stock extinguishment adjustments. The common-stockholder loss is the EPS numerator; comprehensive income is a separate measure. The filing presents basic and diluted EPS and weighted-average common shares together. The reviewed disclosure establishes that presentation, not the cause of equal dilution measures. The heading scales dollars, not share counts: shares and EPS retain scale-zero tags.
